title: Joel Spolsky at Startup School 2012
summary: Joel Spolsky, founder of Fog Creek Software and StackExchange, speaks at Y Combinator's Startup School in 2012. He shares his perspective on building startups.
why: HN recalls it as a well-liked talk from a respected founder, cited on startup ambition and on how few servers StackOverflow needed.

quote.text: I remember Joel Spolsky talked at Startup School a few years back on this subject and he was spot on
